issues.description: All 15 existing extraction candidates are from non-Schwann cell types (alveolar epithelial, Tregs, tumour-associated macrophages, luminal progenitors); none match target_cell_scope L2:Schwann cell and should be excluded from the final marker table.
No Schwann/peripheral glial cells are annotated in this study; Sox10 appears only as a transcription factor associated with alveolar differentiation/tumour expression, not as a Schwann cell marker.

Tam1/Tam2 genes are explicitly 'marked by' in the text, so they should be annotation_marker rather than cluster_enriched/context_only; CD49b+/Sca1− sorting gate is also annotation_marker, with Sca1 negative.
